overview: List of papers records a 1933 Kobe item on the Japanese Woolen Goods Association's metric-system adoption for cloth measurement.

people.name: Donovan
people.role: Sender named in the index entry, apparently a U.S. official at Kobe; precise position is not stated

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on Japanese weights and measures
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes a translation concerning the Japanese Woolen Goods Association’s adoption of metric cloth measures and its request to notify American exporters.
subfiles.summary: Records a 1933 Kobe communication (Donovan) on the Japanese Woolen Goods Association adopting metric cloth measurement, to notify American exporters.

interest: Tracks 1933 Japanese textile-trade metrication notice to exporters.
